name: China Eastern Air Holding Co., Ltd. (中国东方航空集团有限公司)
via: China's State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC) holds 68.42%; China Eastern Airlines' actual controller is the State Council SASAC, per the company's own filings
note: Central state-owned aviation holding company and controlling shareholder of China Eastern Airlines (55.80% as at 21 May 2026). Minority equity holders: China Life investment vehicle 11.21%, Shanghai Jiushi Group 10.19%, China Tourism Group 5.09%, China Reform asset manager 5.09%, per the Dagong credit rating report of June 2026.
